origins.section: Due Weeks as Hard Rules Make the Season Infeasible
Lateness Is max(0, end − due), and Its Weight Is the Risk Carried
The Shortest Season Is Not the Safest One

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-hard: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-hard: The page shows the same crew-week count proving "INFEASIBLE": "36 crew-weeks before week 6, and three crews supply 18. No ordering can fix that." Here 24 are needed and 12 exist.
recorded.prompt:q-early: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-early: "The floor at 0 matters: finishing early earns nothing." L = max(0, 7 − 10) = 0, so w·L = 0.
recorded.prompt:q-compare: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-compare: "OPTIMAL says that no schedule keeping every rule carries less than $360k". The lateness optimum is at most any rule-keeping schedule's risk.

recorded.prompt:q-hard:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-hard:a: The due weeks are hard rules (end <= due), so a job ending at week 6 breaks one. "INFEASIBLE means CP-SAT proved that no schedule meets every rule."
recorded.prompt:q-hard:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-hard:c: The pool caps demand at the capacity ("in every week w ... add up to at most K"), so 8 crews at once with 4 available is not allowed.
recorded.prompt:q-hard:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-hard:d: No schedule meets every rule ("No ordering can fix that"), so no feasible schedule exists to be found. The page's analogue returns INFEASIBLE.
recorded.prompt:q-early:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early:a: "Without it, a job that ends three weeks early would count −3 ... which is not how risk works."
recorded.prompt:q-early:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early:b: "0 if it finishes on time or early". Lateness counts weeks after the due week, not weeks off it.
recorded.prompt:q-early:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-early:c: The objective is "min Σ w_j L_j". There is no per-job charge, and L = 0 here.
recorded.prompt:q-compare:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:a: "Two optimal schedules for two objectives can share every rule and differ in everything the planner cares about." Their risks also differ: $1,038k against $360k.
recorded.prompt:q-compare:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:b: "no schedule keeping every rule carries less than $360k". The makespan schedule cannot carry less than the lateness optimum.
recorded.prompt:q-compare:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compare:d: The OPTIMAL guarantee alone bounds the comparison. The page computes risk "afterwards from its starts" and needs no third model.
